name: Rhythm Battle
hook: Same beat, same notes. Out-hit your friends.
how: A fresh beat is made for every round, and everyone gets the same notes on 4 lanes. Hit each note as it reaches the line: perfect timing scores most, and a long combo multiplies it. Highest score wins.
controls: D F J K (or the arrow keys); on phones, tap the lanes
uses: One player's browser counts in each song, ends it and posts the results; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bot players hit (and miss) along with you until enough people join.
Everyone's score and combo climb on every screen as they play.
ideas: Add hold notes you have to keep pressed
Make the songs faster every round
Give each player an avatar that dances when they hit
